desc: A heavy wooden door opened - entrance, reveal, someone leaving.
prompt: a heavy wooden door on dry iron hinges pushed open slowly, hinges groaning and creaking, then the door stopping against the frame with a dull wooden knock, close microphone, dry
note: Two events in one bed (creak, then knock) and the model will sometimes hand you only one of them. Run three seeds and keep the one with both - that is cheaper than trying to prompt around it. For a slam rather than an open, use impact_hit; do not ask this prompt for a slam.
